name: Swein
title: Herdmaster
examine: He counts the herd at dawn and dusk and twice more for luck, and he will not say the number of the lost aloud, because named misfortune returns.
lines: Count them out, count them in.
A hart knows the horn. Knows the folds. Knows me. Wolves they only know one way.
Do not say the number. Just help me look.
